name: Trakai
summary: A Lithuanian castle town associated with Vytautas and his death in 1430.
overview: Trakai was one of the most important castle centers of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania.
Vytautas died there in 1430, shortly after failed efforts to secure a royal crown.

contentSections.title: Overview
paragraphs: Trakai (New Trakai) was the primary residence and symbol of power for Vytautas the Great, Grand Duke of Lithuania. The castle, built on a lake island, was the center of Lithuanian ducal administration in the late fourteenth and early fifteenth centuries.

contentSections.title: Legacy
paragraphs: Vytautas died at Trakai in 1430 shortly before a planned royal coronation that would have made him King of Lithuania, a project blocked by his cousin Jogaila. The castle and its island setting became closely identified with Lithuanian state formation and Gediminid political identity.
